# RM brief — ABBOTTSFORD RESIDENTIAL MANAGEMENT COMPANY LIMITED (07520850)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-01 — Late filing of annual accounts; CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts; CON-06 — Stale financial information  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- ABBOTTSFORD RESIDENTIAL MANAGEMENT COMPANY LIMITED (company number 07520850) is an active private limited company incorporated on 8 February 2011, filing micro-entity accounts under SIC code 98000 (residents property management). `[profile]`
- The company has a single active officer, with six officers recorded over its life and no new appointments in the last 12 months, so governance rests with one individual. `[officers]`
- No charges are registered at Companies House, so the security position is clean and a first-charge facility could be offered subject to the remaining policies. `[SEC-02]`
- Filing conduct was consistently early for many years, but the accounts made up to 29 February 2024 were filed on 11 September 2025, some 287 days after the deadline, which triggers a referral for weak administrative control. `[AA filed 2025-09-11; AA filed 2023-03-30; AA filed 2022-04-26; CON-01]`
- The latest accounts are micro-entity accounts, which disclose no turnover or profit, so management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained before any credit decision. `[CON-04; profile]`
- Those accounts are made up to 28 February 2025, 19 months before the 30 September 2026 assessment date, so the financial position on record is stale and no longer current. `[CON-06; computed; profile]`
- Overall the case is a REFER: nothing is currently overdue (next accounts due 30 November 2026), but the approach cannot proceed until up-to-date management figures are supplied and the late-filing history is explained. `[profile; CON-01; CON-04; CON-06]`
